name: ClusterFormationStarted
description: Fires when a cluster that has never formed enters Forming. A formed cluster that rolls, scales up or loses servers does not raise it (#444). Announced by the status write that enters Forming, judged from the status that write replaced (writeClusterStatus), never from the pass's own copy: a pass that read the cluster from a cache that had not seen the previous pass's write announced it a second time for every new cluster (#553; knowledge operations.md id 136). There is no ClusterFormationFailed event: formation waits rather than fails, and a cluster that stays unreachable raises ConnectivityDegraded.

name: ClusterReady
description: Fires when a status write takes the cluster into Ready from another phase, as the API server held it (writeClusterStatus, clusterStatusWrite.entered): first formation, back from Degraded, Forming or Failed, a formed cluster short of a server back within its grace from Forming, or an upgrade's completion on a cluster its walk repaired. Announced by that write, once, whichever pass writes it. A Ready write that keeps the phase announces nothing, whatever else it moves — the message of an upgrade that completed or of a server back within the grace, the Degraded condition, a generation, status.version — nor does a pass on a copy from before the Ready write, or an operator restart. Reconcile used to announce every Ready write that moved the phase, message, Ready condition or generation: an upgrade retargeted from 2026.09.9 to 2026.09.0 on a cluster Ready throughout added one (#606; knowledge operations.md id 136).

name: TopologyWarning
description: Fires for each non-fatal warning returned by the spec validator's ValidateWithWarnings during Reconcile. Emitted when the warning starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does (advisoryWarnings in internal/controller/advisory_warnings.go), not on every reconcile pass; a warning that stops applying is forgotten, so one that returns is announced at once.

name: ValidationFailed
description: Fires when an inline spec validator (cluster, standalone, database, sharded database, composite database, alias, replica, plugin, user, role, role binding, auth rule) rejects the CR's spec with hard errors; reconciliation halts until the spec is fixed. Emitted after the status write that records the failure, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition's status or reason — when the failure starts or its message changes — not on every retry while the spec stays invalid, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 136). For a cluster and a standalone this includes a spec.image.tag below status.version (a downgrade), or, for a tag without a patch, below the version the servers report (status.runningVersion, status.upgradeStatus.resolvedTargetVersion; operations.md id 153), checked on every pass; for a cluster the message says "Validation failed" until a pass has accepted the cluster, then "Update validation failed". The message says "validation failed" once: a validator returns its errors alone and the reconciler adds the prefix (the cluster and the sharded database said it twice); the sharded database's event carries its status message. A Neo4jDatabase so refused is in phase ValidationFailed, which kubectl neo4j status --problems lists (knowledge operations.md ids 136, 154).

name: TopologyPlacementFailed
description: Fires when CalculateTopologyPlacement errors, e.g. enforceDistribution requested with fewer discoverable availability zones than servers. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: TopologyPlacementCalculated
description: Fires after a topology placement calculation that found at least one availability zone to spread servers across, naming the zones. Announced when the placement is first calculated and when its zones change, from a per-cluster memory in the topology scheduler, not on every pass (#527; knowledge operations.md id 136); an operator restart announces it once more.

name: TopologyZoneDiscoveryDegraded
description: Fires when cluster-scoped Node listing for AZ auto-discovery fails (typically a namespace-scoped install lacking node RBAC) but zone-based spread/anti-affinity is still applied via the topology label key. Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: PropertyShardingValidationFailed
description: Fires when spec.propertySharding is enabled but fails version, cluster-size, required-config-key, or resource-minimum validation. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). The message says "validation failed" once: the version check's error no longer carries a prefix of its own (#549).

name: ServerRoleValidationFailed
description: Fires when ValidateServerRoleHints rejects spec.topology.serverRoles, e.g. an out-of-range serverIndex, a duplicate index, or every server set to SECONDARY. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: StorageClassNotFound
description: Fires when spec.storage.className names a StorageClass that doesn't exist, before any StatefulSet is created — otherwise the pod would stay Pending indefinitely with no signal. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: RouteAPINotFound
description: Fires when an OpenShift Route (or MCP Route) is configured but route.openshift.io/v1 isn't registered in the cluster, so Route reconciliation is skipped. Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: MCPApocMissing
description: Fires when spec.mcp.enabled is true but no enabled Neo4jPlugin named apoc/apoc-extended targets this cluster or standalone, since MCP stdio mode needs APOC procedures. Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: ReconcileFailed
description: Fires when a controller's inner reconcile helper chain (TLS/ConfigMap/Service/StatefulSet for standalone; create/drop/status-refresh for a Neo4jShardedDatabase) returns an error, before status is set to Failed. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). Not raised by a Neo4jShardedDatabase for a statement Neo4j asks to be retried (a cluster that lost its majority still reads Ready): that is a wait, reported as ClientCreationFailed only after 5 minutes (operations.md id 210).

name: UpgradeStarted
description: Fires when a rolling upgrade's pre-flight gates (version compatibility, StatefulSet readiness, pre-upgrade health) pass and the state machine transitions into Staging (cluster, whatever its upgradeStrategy), or when the standalone begins its own pre-upgrade check on the pass that applies a new image (once per image: not again while the pod is being replaced). A Paused or Failed upgrade taken up again is announced as resumed ("Rolling upgrade resumed after it was Paused"). A held upgrade taken up to replace the servers that cannot start on its target names them: '... cannot start on <target> and is replaced first' (operations.md id 162).

name: UpgradeCompleted
description: Fires when stepUpgradeVerifying confirms every server reports the target version and the Completed phase is persisted.

name: UpgradePaused
description: A Warning that fires when a rolling-upgrade step fails and upgradeStrategy.autoPauseOnFailure is set, halting the state machine for manual intervention; the servers stay where it stopped until the user changes spec.image.tag or turns autoPauseOnFailure off (operations.md id 149). A refusal before the upgrade starts is announced once, and the cluster stays Ready.

name: UpgradeFailed
description: Fires when a rolling-upgrade step's deadline or gate is exceeded without autoPauseOnFailure set, or when the standalone's pre-upgrade health check fails with autoPauseOnFailure set. The standalone's pre-upgrade health check, which holds the upgrade back and is re-run every RequeueAfter, is advisory: announced when the block starts and every 30 minutes while it lasts (knowledge operations.md id 145). A cluster upgrade a check refuses before it starts is announced once per refusal — again only when the phase, target or error changes — while the operator tries it every minute; the cluster stays Ready (operations.md id 149).

name: UpgradeRetargeted
description: A Normal event that fires when spec.image.tag changes while a cluster upgrade is mid-flight (Staging, Rolling, Stabilizing or Verifying): the upgrade goes on towards the new tag, staged again ('Rolling upgrade retargeted from A to B during Rolling; the new target is staged'). Announced once per new target, from the status write that records it, judged from the record that write re-read, so a pass whose cached copy still names the old target says nothing (operations.md ids 136, 180). It used to be an info log line only. A Paused or Failed upgrade taken up towards a new tag is announced by UpgradeStarted ('resumed') instead.

name: UpgradeDeferred
description: Fires when an image change is held back: the cluster is not Ready with every server available (holdImageDriftUntilReady), or a scale-down drain is in progress (mutual exclusion — the drain must finish first). Announced once per held target from a per-cluster memory, not on every check: the drain's deferral names the target and was emitted every 15s while the drain ran (#527); the memory is forgotten when the drain releases its hold, so a later drain announces again (knowledge operations.md id 136). Also when the normal pass holds an image change because the cluster is not Ready with every server available: announced on the second pass that holds the same image, once (the pass after a refused tag is fixed holds it for one pass only, #550), and not for a change a stopped upgrade's record already names.

name: ScaleDownBlocked
description: Fires when a scale-down cannot proceed: below the system database's minimum voting-member floor, a DEALLOCATE dry-run fails, or a DROP SERVER fails — replicas stay held at the current count. Announced from the ServersPendingDrain condition write, once per cause (its message), never from the pass's own copy of the condition, which a lagging cache can hand over from before the last pass's write (#565; knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ScaleDownDraining
description: Fires on each successful drain step (cordon, deallocate, or drop) as the scale-down worker walks servers being removed by a topology shrink toward zero.

name: StorageExpansionStarted
description: Fires when a PVC size comparison finds at least one PVC smaller than spec.storage.size, before any PVC is patched.

name: StorageExpansionCompleted
description: Fires after every undersized PVC has been patched to the new size and the owning StatefulSet orphan-deleted for recreation with updated VolumeClaimTemplates.

name: StorageExpansionFailed
description: Fires when a storage shrink is rejected, the StorageClass doesn't allow expansion, or patching a PVC / orphan-deleting the StatefulSet itself errors. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ConnectivityDegraded
description: Fires once per outage streak, at the 10th consecutive reconcile that fails to reach Neo4j over Bolt, so a persistent outage is distinguishable from a transient rolling-restart blip.

name: SplitBrainDetected
description: Fires when per-pod SHOW SERVERS views diverge into more than one cluster group and at least one minority pod sees servers outside the majority's view.

name: SplitBrainRepaired
description: Fires after the orphaned pods identified by split-brain analysis have been deleted for the StatefulSet to recreate and rejoin the majority.

name: ServerPodReplaced
description: A Normal event on a cluster: the operator deleted a server pod that cannot start (an image it cannot pull, a container that keeps exiting, an init container that failed) and that the StatefulSet's rolling update is to replace — at or above the partition, on an older revision than an update revision the StatefulSet controller has seen — so that the StatefulSet creates it again from the new template. With MaxUnavailableStatefulSet on (Kubernetes 1.35.0–1.35.3) the StatefulSet controller replaces no pod while one is unavailable, so every repair of a cluster short of a server (a plugin's init container or settings, a held upgrade's new tag, a corrected spec) waited for ever. One per pod deleted; where the StatefulSet controller deletes the pod first, nothing is announced (operations.md id 204).

name: SplitBrainRepairFailed
description: Fires when deleting an orphaned pod during automatic split-brain repair itself errors.

name: AuraFleetManagementFailed
description: Fires when Phase 2 Aura Fleet Management token registration fails (Secret unreadable, plugin check or registerToken errors) — the cluster/standalone itself remains operational. Raised when a failure first appears or its message changes, not on every retry; the current message is also in status.auraFleetManagement.message.

name: AuraFleetManagementPluginPatchFailed
description: Fires when the live StatefulSet patch that merges fleet-management into NEO4J_PLUGINS fails. Not raised for a server StatefulSet that does not exist yet — a new cluster's first pass reaches the patch before it writes its StatefulSet, and a new standalone reads the one it just created from a cache that has not seen it — since the write that creates the StatefulSet already lists the plugin (#531; knowledge operations.md ids 164, 175). Announced when the failure starts or its error text changes, not on every pass while it lasts: the reconciler remembers the last one per deployment (lastAnnounced), forgets it when the patch goes through or the deployment is deleted, so a failure that comes back is announced again (operations.md id 145). Worded for the step that failed (fleetPluginPatchFailure): "Failed to add fleet-management to NEO4J_PLUGINS" only for the StatefulSet write, "Could not check the server StatefulSet's NEO4J_PLUGINS for fleet-management" for the check before it (the StatefulSet unreadable, no neo4j container, an unparseable list) — all a pass does on an image with Fleet Manager built in (2026.03+), where nothing is added (operations.md id 192).

name: AuraFleetManagementRegistered
description: Fires once fleetManagement.registerToken succeeds against a Ready cluster or standalone instance.

name: AuraFleetDeploymentCreated
description: Fleet Manager provisioning (spec.auraFleetManagement.provision, Phase 0) registered a new Fleet Manager deployment in Aura with CreateDeployment, after recording its ID in the neo4j.com/external-fleet-deployment-id annotation, the idempotency guard (knowledge operations.md id 86).

name: AuraFleetDeploymentAdopted
description: Fleet Manager provisioning found a deployment of the same name in the Aura project and bound the cluster or standalone to it instead of creating another — also how a pass recovers after the annotation write that followed a create failed (that failure is in status.auraFleetManagement.message; operations.md id 88).

name: AuraFleetDeploymentDeleted
description: Deleting a cluster or standalone whose provision block says deletionPolicy: Delete revoked the deployment's token and unregistered the Fleet Manager deployment in Aura. Best-effort: a failure is logged, and never holds the finalizer.

name: AuraFleetTokenProvisioned
description: A freshly minted fleet registration token was stored in its Secret (spec.provision.tokenSecretName, default <name>-aura-fleet-token), which Phase 2 then registers over Bolt. Aura returns a token exactly once, so it is stored straight after the mint.

name: AuraFleetTokenRotated
description: Warning: under tokenPolicy: Rotate the token Secret was missing, so the deployment's token was rotated and the new one stored; any previous registration is now invalid, and status.auraFleetManagement.registered was cleared first so Phase 2 registers the new one. Emitted once the new token is stored: while the Secret cannot be written each attempt rotates again, with no event, and the status message says why (knowledge operations.md ids 88, 136).

name: ValidationWarning
description: An inline spec validator (DatabaseValidator, AliasValidator, ReplicaValidator, etc.) surfaced a non-fatal warning; reconciliation continues. Also raised, in the form 'spec.<path> is accepted but has no effect today: <what to do instead>', when a spec field the schema accepts but nothing reads is set, or a value that has no effect (upgradeStrategy.strategy Recreate on a cluster; a standalone's upgradeStrategy timeouts other than their defaults; an OpenShift Route's tls.secretName, which no Route the operator writes names, #536); and while spec.storage.className names a StorageClass the existing data volumes do not use. Raised on Neo4jEnterpriseCluster, Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone, Neo4jPlugin, Neo4jDatabase, Neo4jBackup, Neo4jRestore and AuraInstance. Emitted when the warning starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does (advisoryWarnings in internal/controller/advisory_warnings.go), not on every reconcile pass; a warning that stops applying is forgotten, so one that returns is announced at once.

name: ClusterNotFound
description: The CR's clusterRef did not resolve to a Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone (a Neo4jShardedDatabase: a cluster) in the namespace. The resource waits in phase Pending and carries on once it exists: Neo4jDatabase, Neo4jShardedDatabase, Neo4jUser, Neo4jRole, Neo4jRoleBinding, Neo4jAuthRule, Neo4jCompositeDatabase, Neo4jDatabaseAlias, Neo4jReplicaDatabase, Neo4jPlugin (a Neo4jPlugin was Failed before, and installs as usual once its target exists), Neo4jRestore, and Neo4jBackup, which keeps its documented phase Waiting; the backup and the restore say "Waiting for target to appear: …" (operations.md id 198). A missing deployment is never a validation failure (operations.md id 182). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per wait, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (id 145). For an object whose target went away, only if the object outlasts the target by a minute; a teardown raises none (operations.md id 216).

name: ClusterNotReady
description: On a Neo4jShardedDatabase: the referenced cluster cannot host it, because property sharding needs Neo4j 2025.12+ and spec.propertySharding.enabled on the cluster; phase Failed. A cluster that is not Ready yet is phase Waiting, with no event. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ConnectionFailed
description: The operator could not open a Bolt client connection to the resolved cluster/standalone target. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). For a Neo4jUser, Neo4jRole, Neo4jRoleBinding or Neo4jAuthRule whose target reads Ready but cannot be reached (connection refused, EOF, a timeout, an unresolvable host, the system database unavailable), it is raised only when that outage has lasted more than 5 minutes; until then the object waits with ClusterNotReady=True, reason ClusterUnreachable, and a Ready one stays Ready (operations.md id 172). A target that reads Ready but cannot be reached is a wait (ClusterNotReady=True, reason ClusterUnreachable), reported as ConnectionFailed only after 5 minutes — for users, roles, bindings and auth rules (id 172) and for Neo4jDatabase, Neo4jCompositeDatabase, Neo4jDatabaseAlias and Neo4jReplicaDatabase (id 183). An all-databases Neo4jRestore raises it once when its target has not answered for 5 minutes, and goes on waiting (id 206). A database, composite, alias, replica or sharded database whose target reads Ready but answers its statements with an error Neo4j asks to be retried (a cluster that lost its majority) waits the same way, with the same clock, and is reported only after 5 minutes (operations.md id 210).

name: CreationFailed
description: The CREATE DATABASE Cypher call for a Neo4jDatabase failed. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). Not raised for a statement Neo4j asks to be retried (a cluster that lost its majority still reads Ready): that is a wait, ClusterNotReady=True with reason ClusterUnreachable, reported as ConnectionFailed only after 5 minutes (operations.md id 210).

name: DataImportFailed
description: One of spec.initialData.cypherStatements failed to execute against the newly created database. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: DataImported
description: spec.initialData's Cypher statements executed successfully; status.dataImported is marked true.

name: DataSeeded
description: A database created from spec.seedURI is marked as having its data sourced from the seed rather than initialData.

name: DatabaseReady
description: The Neo4jDatabase became ready: the status write set the Ready condition to True with reason DatabaseReady where it was not before (first creation, or back from a failure of its own). Not emitted again while the database stays Ready, not after an operator restart, since the transition is read from the persisted condition (reportDatabaseReady; knowledge operations.md id 136), and not after a restart of its host: a Ready database stays Ready with ClusterNotReady=True while the host is not Ready or does not answer (operations.md id 183).

name: DatabaseCreatedFromSeed
description: CREATE DATABASE with a seedURI/seedURIs OPTIONS clause (with or without an explicit topology) succeeded.

name: DeletionFailed
description: DROP DATABASE failed, or the operator could not create a client for the host, during Neo4jDatabase finalizer cleanup. The finalizer is kept and the failure recorded in status (phase Error, Ready reason DeletionFailed, the message); the event is emitted only when that write changed the status - once per failure while the drop is retried on every pass, not on every retry (operations.md id 145). Once the five-minute grace period has passed the finalizer is released with one more event naming the database left in Neo4j and the DROP DATABASE that removes it. A client that cannot be created used to release the finalizer at once (operations.md id 178). A server name that does not resolve during a restart ('no such host') is one of these retried failures, no longer a release.

name: DatabaseDeleted
description: DROP DATABASE succeeded during Neo4jDatabase finalizer cleanup.

name: AliasCreated
description: CREATE ALIAS succeeded for a Neo4jDatabaseAlias that had no live alias yet.

name: AliasRetargeted
description: The live alias's target database drifted from spec.targetDatabase and ALTER ALIAS ... SET TARGET corrected it (spec wins).

name: AliasReady
description: The Neo4jDatabaseAlias resolves to its intended target database. Announced from the status write that moves the alias into Ready, once; a Ready alias stays Ready (ClusterNotReady=True) while its target restarts (operations.md id 183).

name: AliasDropped
description: DROP ALIAS succeeded during Neo4jDatabaseAlias finalizer cleanup.

name: AliasFailed
description: An alias lookup, CREATE, ALTER, or DROP Cypher call failed. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (operations.md id 145). On deletion: A deletion whose cleanup cannot run — the target not Ready, refusing the connection, its admin Secret unreadable, or Neo4j refusing the statement — keeps the finalizer and waits, with 'deletion waits to remove …' in status.message and this Warning once; after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) the finalizer is released with one more Warning, 'Released the finalizer without removing …', naming what is left in Neo4j and the statement that removes it. Only a target CR that is gone releases at once (operations.md id 178). Not raised for a statement Neo4j asks to be retried while reconciling (a cluster that lost its majority still reads Ready): that is a wait, ClusterNotReady=True with reason ClusterUnreachable, reported as ConnectionFailed only after 5 minutes (operations.md id 210).

name: ClientCreationFailed
description: The operator could not construct a Neo4j Bolt client for a Neo4jShardedDatabase's referenced cluster. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A cluster that reads Ready but cannot be reached is a wait (ClusterNotReady=True, reason ClusterUnreachable), reported only after 5 minutes (operations.md id 183). So is a cluster that answers the statements with an error Neo4j asks to be retried, one that lost its majority (operations.md id 210).

name: ShardedDatabaseReady
description: The property-sharded database became ready: the status write moved the CR to phase Ready (graph shard online in SHOW DATABASES), or a destructive replaceExisting pass recreated it. Not emitted again while it stays Ready (knowledge operations.md id 136). Each pass reads the CR through the uncached APIReader, so a pass started by the Ready write cannot read the earlier phase from the cache, write it over Ready and announce Ready a second time (knowledge operations.md ids 94, 136). A Ready sharded database stays Ready with ClusterNotReady=True while its cluster rolls or restarts, so the cluster's return is not a transition (operations.md id 183).

name: ShardedDatabaseDropped
description: DROP DATABASE ... DESTROY DATA succeeded ahead of a spec.replaceExisting+force destructive re-seed.

name: SeedBackupPending
description: The Neo4jShardedDatabase is waiting for its seedBackupRef's Neo4jBackup to produce a Succeeded run before it can seed. Emitted when the wait starts (the status write changes the phase or message), not on every retry (knowledge operations.md id 136).

name: SeedBackupResolutionFailed
description: Resolving seedBackupRef into concrete seed URIs failed permanently (missing Neo4jBackup CR, unsupported storage type, or missing per-shard filenames). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: SeedProxyStarting
description: The operator-managed PVC seed-proxy Deployment fronting a PVC-backed backup is not yet Ready. Emitted when the wait starts (the status write changes the phase or message), not on every retry (knowledge operations.md id 136).

name: SeedCredsMissing
description: The target cluster/standalone lacks the cloud credentials Secret a seedURI/seedBackupRef needs (or, for a Neo4jShardedDatabase, the custom S3 endpoint on its server pods), and auto-inherit is not enabled. Nothing has been asked of Neo4j yet: the Neo4jDatabase or Neo4jShardedDatabase waits in phase Pending (it was Unknown, resp. Failed) and is created by itself once the target has them. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per wait, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: SeedCredsAutoInherited
description: The operator patched the target's spec.extraEnvFrom with the seed credentials Secret (and spec.env with a custom S3 endpoint, for a Neo4jRestore or a Neo4jShardedDatabase seed) and is waiting for the resulting rolling restart. The database is phase Pending meanwhile.

name: ReplicaCreated
description: CreateReplicaDatabaseFromBackup succeeded, creating a new cross-cluster replica database on the Neo4jReplicaDatabase's target.

name: ReplicaReady
description: The replica database is online and actively replicating from its upstream (reported with its current transaction lag). Announced from the status write that moves the replica into Replicating, once; a Replicating replica stays Replicating (ClusterNotReady=True) while its downstream target restarts (operations.md id 183).

name: ReplicaFailed
description: A replica database lookup, create, or drop Cypher call failed. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (operations.md id 145). On deletion (including a database type that cannot be read, which is never taken for a promoted database): A deletion whose cleanup cannot run — the target not Ready, refusing the connection, its admin Secret unreadable, or Neo4j refusing the statement — keeps the finalizer and waits, with 'deletion waits to remove …' in status.message and this Warning once; after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) the finalizer is released with one more Warning, 'Released the finalizer without removing …', naming what is left in Neo4j and the statement that removes it. Only a target CR that is gone releases at once (operations.md id 178). Not raised for a lookup or create Neo4j asks to be retried (a cluster that lost its majority still reads Ready): that is a wait, ClusterNotReady=True with reason ClusterUnreachable, reported as ConnectionFailed only after 5 minutes (operations.md id 210).

name: ReplicaDropped
description: DROP DATABASE succeeded for a still-type=replica database during Neo4jReplicaDatabase finalizer cleanup.

name: ReplicaRetainedAfterPromotion
description: Deletion was refused because the live database's type is no longer replica (it was promoted); the finalizer is released without dropping the database.

name: ReplicaPromotionDetected
description: The Neo4jReplicaDatabase reconciler observed the live database's type flip away from replica out of band (not via this operator's own Neo4jReplicaPromotion completing on this CR).

name: ReplicaVersionTooOld
description: The target cluster's Neo4j version is below the minimum required to host a cross-cluster replica (MinCCDRReplicaVersion). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ReplicaObjectStoreEnvMissing
description: A backup-mode Neo4jReplicaDatabase's downstream servers have no AWS_REGION (or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION) in any source of their environment, so Neo4j could not read the s3:// seed or pulls. Nothing has been asked of Neo4j: the replica waits in phase Pending and is created by itself once the servers have it (checked every two minutes). It was ReplicaFailed with phase Failed before. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per wait, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ReplicaPromotionStarted
description: The irreversible replica-promote call is about to be issued; the in-flight replication lag at this instant becomes permanent data loss. Emitted when the promotion enters Promoting, not on a retry of the PROMOTE call nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ReplicaPromotionCompleted
description: A post-promote CHECK confirmed the live database's type is no longer replica; the promotion is recorded as terminal.

name: ReplicaPromotionFailed
description: The promotion could not proceed or be confirmed (referenced Neo4jReplicaDatabase/database missing, unreachable cluster, or a failed promote call). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: BackupScheduled
description: A scheduled Neo4jBackup's CronJob is armed. Emitted when the status write changes the phase or message to Scheduled — first creation, back from another phase (Suspended, Waiting), or a changed schedule, since the message names the CronJob and its schedule — not on every reconcile (knowledge operations.md id 136).

name: BackupStarted
description: A one-time backup Job was created for a Neo4jBackup CR.

name: BackupCompleted
description: The backup Job reached JobComplete and its run (including artifact filenames, or what was read of them within artifactCaptureGrace) was recorded in status.history. Emitted once, from the status write that makes the one-time backup Completed; a Completed backup is never reopened (backup-restore.md Rules 113, 174).

name: BackupFailed
description: The Neo4jBackup spec was invalid, or the backup Job failed terminally (BackoffLimit exhausted or startup timeout). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A failed backup Job's event says why: "Backup job <name> failed (<Job reason>: <message>): backup exited with code <n>: <last lines>", as status.message and the run's status.history[].error do; it was "Backup job failed" alone (operations.md id 215).

name: BackupRetentionCaveat
description: Warns that filename-level PVC retention pruning can orphan differential artifacts whose parent FULL backup ages out (chain-aware pruning needs neo4j-admin backup aggregate).

name: BackupShardedDatabasesExcluded
description: An all-databases backup captured property-sharded databases as per-shard artifacts (status.shardedFamilies) that its own all-databases restore path cannot recreate; each must restore via its Neo4jShardedDatabase CR. Emitted once per run, after the status write that records the run in status.history, and only for runs the write kept (not on a conflict retry, a pass that defers the run, or a run the ten-entry cap trims) (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: BackupShardedDifferential
description: A backup run wrote differential backups of sharded-database shards to a PVC; no sharded database can be seeded from that run, since over HTTP Neo4j seeds one only from a full backup of every shard. Emitted once per run, after the status write that records the run in status.history, and only for runs the write kept (not on a conflict retry, a pass that defers the run, or a run the ten-entry cap trims) (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: ReplicationSourceCaveat
description: Published the exact directory a downstream cross-cluster replica should pull from (spec.mode=replication-source), or warned that the storage type has no cross-cluster URI form. The Warning is advisory: once, then every 30 minutes while the storage stays without that form, not on every scheduled pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: ServiceAccountAnnotationConflict
description: Two backup/restore CRs in the same namespace declared different workload-identity annotations on the shared neo4j-backup-sa/neo4j-restore-sa ServiceAccount; the last-reconciled CR's annotations win. On a Neo4jBackup it is advisory: two CRs that disagree overwrite each other on every pass, and each says so once every 30 minutes (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: BackupValidateUnsupported
description: options.validate was requested but `neo4j-admin backup validate` doesn't exist on this Neo4j image (it requires a CalVer 2025.x+ image). Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: RestoreStarted
description: A restore attempt started, announced once: a restore Job was created — "Restore job … started", from the status write that made the restore Running, so a pass on a stale copy does not repeat it — carrying, for a standalone restore that runs offline with neo4j-admin, the reason and, with stopCluster true, that it stops the standalone (with stopCluster false, that it is stopped already); emitted only once the existence check, the pre-restore hooks and the stop (or the refusal of a running standalone) have passed. The reason used to be a RestoreStarted of its own, so one offline restore emitted two (#573; restoreJobStartedMessage; knowledge operations.md id 145). Also: a cluster-native Cypher recreate was issued, or an all-databases restore started — once, from the markDatabaseResult write that made it Running, naming how many databases it restores; a database starting is recorded in status.databaseResults only (operations.md id 166). An online restore announces it once too, "Online restore into …", with "spec.stopCluster is ignored …" in the same message for a standalone restored online with stopCluster true; that notice was a RestoreStarted of its own (operations.md id 215).

name: RestoreCompleted
description: The Neo4jRestore reconcile reached its terminal Completed phase; for an all-databases restore once, from the status write, on the restore's own event budget (knowledge operations.md id 166).

name: RestoreFailed
description: The restore Job, Cypher recreate/online-wait, or seed-proxy/seed-config setup failed terminally; for an all-databases restore once, when a database failed, from the status write. A failed restore Job's event says why: "Restore job <name> failed (<Job reason>: <message>): neo4j-restore exited with code <n>: <last lines>", as status.message does; it was "Restore job failed" alone. An online restore over a database that exists without replaceExisting raises it once, and returns no error (operations.md id 215).

name: RestoreFromChainParent
description: The resolved backup run is a differential artifact that depends on a FULL backup from a chainFromBackup parent CR. Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: DatabaseCreateFailed
description: The restored database (or one of several, in an all-databases restore) could not be created/started/brought online after an otherwise-successful restore.

name: SeedEndpointNotProjected
description: An online restore's target (cluster or standalone) has server pods that cannot reach the cloud seed source: the credentials Secret or custom S3 endpoint is missing and the target is not opted in to auto-inherit. Emitted when the restore starts waiting in Pending; it carries on once the target has them. Announced when the status write (transitionRestoreStatus, which re-reads the restore) changed the phase or message, not from the pass's own copy, so two passes on a copy from before the first write announce it once (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: RestoreDatabaseFailed
description: One database of an all-databases restore could not be restored (it exists and options.replaceExisting is not set, Neo4j refused the create or recreate, or the backup recorded no artifact for it); the others carry on and the restore ends Failed with RestoreFailed. A Warning, once per database, from the markDatabaseResult write that records the database Failed, through ProgressRecorder (source neo4j-restore-progress), so it spends neither the restore's own budget nor the Normal progress budget (knowledge operations.md id 166).

name: RestoreSeedProgress
description: An all-databases restore's progress summary: databases restored and failed so far, the database being seeded with its progress (allocation counts or the last poll's error) and how long it has shown it — "unchanged for 40m" is a stall. One per restore on its first seed poll, then one every 10 minutes while it seeds, from the source neo4j-restore-progress: half that source's refill, so every one reaches the API server whatever the number of databases, and the restore's outcome is never crowded out. It was one per database change, which outran the budget on a large restore (55 of 101 delivered) (knowledge operations.md ids 92, 166).

name: RestoreShardedDatabasesNotCovered
description: An all-databases restore does not recreate property-sharded databases in its per-database loop; each must be restored via its own Neo4jShardedDatabase CR (spec.seedBackupRef) pointed at the same backup. Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: UserCreated
description: Emitted when CreateUserAdvanced successfully creates a new Neo4j user for a Neo4jUser CR (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserUpdated
description: Emitted when an ALTER USER clause set is applied for an existing Neo4jUser CR, or when Neo4j says the password is already the Secret's — the latter only when the status write that records the password as applied changed it, so once, not on every retry of a pass that then fails (neo4juser_controller.go; operations.md id 15). For an already-matching password it is the only event — no PasswordRotated beside it, never both (operations.md id 15).

name: UserDeleted
description: Emitted after DROP USER succeeds during Neo4jUser deletion cleanup (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserReady
description: Emitted when a Neo4jUser becomes Ready — granted roles match spec.roles with no pending dependencies — the first time, or back from a failure of its own (neo4juser_controller.go). Announced from the status write that moved the persisted phase into Ready (writeStatus reports entered), never from the pass's copy; a Ready user stays Ready while its target restarts, so a restart is not announced (knowledge operations.md id 158).

name: UserDeletionFailed
description: Emitted when DROP USER cannot run during Neo4jUser deletion (neo4juser_controller.go): status phase Failed, Ready reason UserDeletionFailed, announced when that write changed it — once per failure, not on every retry (operations.md id 145). A deletion whose cleanup cannot run — the target not Ready, refusing the connection, its admin Secret unreadable, or Neo4j refusing the statement — keeps the finalizer and waits, with 'deletion waits to remove …' in status.message and this Warning once; after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) the finalizer is released with one more Warning, 'Released the finalizer without removing …', naming what is left in Neo4j and the statement that removes it. Only a target CR that is gone releases at once (operations.md id 178).

name: UserSyncFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/create/alter/role-grant failure during Neo4jUser reconciliation, moving the CR to phase Failed (neo4juser_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A Failed user keeps its failure while its target restarts (recordTargetWait, settledAtGeneration), so the same failure met when the target is back is not announced again (#573; operations.md id 189).

name: PasswordRotated
description: Emitted when the status write right after the statement that applied the password (CREATE USER, ALTER USER … SET PASSWORD, or Neo4j's 'already the same' refusal) changed status.passwordSecretHash — once per Secret version, at a user's creation and at each change of its Secret, never from the pass's copy (passwordApplied, neo4juser_controller.go; operations.md id 15). Not announced when Neo4j refused the ALTER because it already held the password: that is the 'already matches' UserUpdated alone, never both (operations.md id 15).

name: RolesGranted
description: Emitted after one or more GRANT ROLE statements succeed for a Neo4jUser or Neo4jRoleBinding (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: RolesRevoked
description: Emitted after one or more REVOKE ROLE statements succeed for a Neo4jUser or Neo4jRoleBinding (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: RolesResolved
description: Emitted by Neo4jUser and Neo4jRoleBinding when spec.roles names a Neo4jRole by its CR metadata.name and the operator grants the Neo4j role that CR manages (#260 CR-name resolution). The mapping is recorded in the RoleNamesResolved condition (present only while there is one), and the event is emitted only when that write changed it - the mapping appeared or changed - not on every pass, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 136) (reportResolvedRoles in neo4juser_controller.go and neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: RolePending
description: Emitted when a desired role name exists nowhere — not a built-in, not a Neo4jRole CR, not a role in Neo4j (SHOW ROLES, read only when needed; missingRoles in role_resolution.go) — deferring the grant until the role exists (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go, neo4jauthrule_controller.go). Emitted after the PendingDependencies condition write, which names the missing roles sorted, and only when that write changed it: once per wait, and again when the missing set changes (knowledge operations.md ids 17, 145).

name: RoleCreated
description: Emitted when CreateRoleAdvanced successfully creates a new Neo4j role for a Neo4jRole CR (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: RoleDeleted
description: Emitted after DROP ROLE succeeds during Neo4jRole deletion cleanup (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: RoleReady
description: Emitted when a Neo4jRole becomes Ready — privileges match spec.privileges — the first time, or back from a failure of its own (reportReady, neo4jrole_controller.go). Announced from the status write that moved the persisted phase into Ready, never from the pass's copy; a Ready role stays Ready while its target restarts (knowledge operations.md id 158). A new role whose statements wait for their database announces it only once they are applied, after its PrivilegesApplied (operations.md id 216).

name: RoleDeletionFailed
description: Emitted when DROP ROLE cannot run during Neo4jRole deletion (neo4jrole_controller.go): status phase Failed, Ready reason RoleDeletionFailed, announced once per failure, not on every retry (operations.md id 145). A deletion whose cleanup cannot run — the target not Ready, refusing the connection, its admin Secret unreadable, or Neo4j refusing the statement — keeps the finalizer and waits, with 'deletion waits to remove …' in status.message and this Warning once; after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) the finalizer is released with one more Warning, 'Released the finalizer without removing …', naming what is left in Neo4j and the statement that removes it. Only a target CR that is gone releases at once (operations.md id 178).

name: RoleSyncFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/create/privilege-apply/revoke failure during Neo4jRole reconciliation, moving the CR to phase Failed (neo4jrole_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A Failed role keeps its failure while its target restarts, so the same failure afterwards is not announced again (operations.md id 189).

name: PrivilegesApplied
description: Emitted when privilege statements changed a role: GRANT/DENY statements whose grant created a row, plus derived REVOKEs (neo4jrole_controller.go finishReconcile). In learn mode a re-learn — after a change to an alias the role's statements name (any alias, for a role with a statement whose targets cannot be read), a new image, or a vanished unattributed row — re-grants every statement of that role once; grants that create nothing are not counted, so an unchanged role reports nothing (knowledge operations.md ids 136, 142).

name: PrivilegesDriftKept
description: Emitted when a currently-granted privilege cannot be reconciled away — either it is immutable or no REVOKE can be textually derived — leaving PrivilegesSynced false (neo4jrole_controller.go). Advisory: emitted through advisoryWarnings when it starts to apply and again every 30 minutes while it still does, not on every pass (knowledge operations.md ids 102, 145).

name: BindingCreated
description: Emitted when a Neo4jRoleBinding becomes Ready with all desired roles granted to its target user, the first time or back from a failure of its own (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go). Announced from the status write that moved the persisted phase into Ready, never from the pass's copy; a Ready binding stays Ready while its target restarts (knowledge operations.md id 158).

name: BindingUpdated
description: Emitted when an already-Ready Neo4jRoleBinding's granted-role set changes on a subsequent reconcile, as the status write that records it reports (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go; knowledge operations.md id 158).

name: BindingDeleted
description: Emitted after all previously-granted roles are revoked during Neo4jRoleBinding deletion cleanup (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: BindingFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/grant/revoke failure during Neo4jRoleBinding reconciliation or deletion (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (operations.md id 145). On deletion: A deletion whose cleanup cannot run — the target not Ready, refusing the connection, its admin Secret unreadable, or Neo4j refusing the statement — keeps the finalizer and waits, with 'deletion waits to remove …' in status.message and this Warning once; after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) the finalizer is released with one more Warning, 'Released the finalizer without removing …', naming what is left in Neo4j and the statement that removes it. Only a target CR that is gone releases at once (operations.md id 178). The Warning lists the roles still granted.

name: UserNotFound
description: Emitted when a Neo4jRoleBinding's target username does not exist in Neo4j; bindings never create the user, only manage grants for externally provisioned users (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A binding waiting for its user keeps that wait while its target restarts, so it is not announced again for the same user (operations.md id 189).

name: AuthRuleCreated
description: Emitted when CREATE OR REPLACE AUTH RULE runs for the first time for a Neo4jAuthRule CR (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleUpdated
description: Emitted when CREATE OR REPLACE AUTH RULE re-applies a changed condition or enabled flag for an existing Neo4jAuthRule (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleDeleted
description: Emitted after DROP AUTH RULE succeeds during Neo4jAuthRule deletion cleanup (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/create/grant/revoke failure during Neo4jAuthRule reconciliation, and when DROP AUTH RULE cannot run during deletion (neo4jauthrule_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (operations.md id 145). On deletion: A deletion whose cleanup cannot run — the target not Ready, refusing the connection, its admin Secret unreadable, or Neo4j refusing the statement — keeps the finalizer and waits, with 'deletion waits to remove …' in status.message and this Warning once; after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) the finalizer is released with one more Warning, 'Released the finalizer without removing …', naming what is left in Neo4j and the statement that removes it. Only a target CR that is gone releases at once (operations.md id 178).

name: AuthRuleVersionTooOld
description: Emitted when the target cluster's Neo4j version does not support AUTH RULE (older than 2026.03), gating the Neo4jAuthRule to phase Failed (neo4jauthrule_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: OIDCProviderNotConfigured
description: Emitted when the target cluster's spec.config does not set dbms.security.abac.authorization_providers, a prerequisite for ABAC auth rules (neo4jauthrule_controller.go). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: AuraInstanceAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing Aura instance by name and binds the CR to it instead of creating a new one.

name: AuraInstanceCreated
description: Emitted after CreateInstance (v1) or CreateInstanceV2 (multi-database) succeeds and the external-instance-id annotation has been persisted.

name: AuraInstanceUpdated
description: Emitted after reconcileDrift's PatchInstance call converges memory/storage/name/secondariesCount/cdcEnrichmentMode.

name: AuraInstancePaused
description: Emitted when reconcilePauseResume calls PauseInstance because spec.paused=true on a running instance.

name: AuraInstanceResumed
description: Emitted when reconcilePauseResume calls ResumeInstance because spec.paused=false on a paused instance.

name: AuraInstanceUpgraded
description: Emitted when reconcileUpgrade calls UpgradeInstance to move a professional-db instance to business-critical.

name: AuraInstanceDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteInstance under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraInstanceOrphaned
description: Emitted (Normal) when handleDeletion leaves the cloud instance running under the default Orphan deletionPolicy, or when managementPolicies does not permit Delete. A Warning instead when deletionPolicy is Delete but the Aura credentials could not be resolved for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) after deletion was requested: the finalizer is released without deleting, and the message says the resource was left in Aura (knowledge operations.md id 157). Also a Warning when Aura kept refusing the DELETE (not a conflict, not transient) for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod: the cloud instance keeps running (operations.md id 201).

name: AuraInstanceFailed
description: Emitted by fail() on any reconcile failure (credentials, project ID, create, observe) and by handleDeletion when deletionProtection blocks a requested delete. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). Also records a Delete that waits for Aura credentials it cannot resolve (reason CredentialsUnavailable, id 157). fail() sets status.phase=Error with the Ready condition (id 156). A 429, a 5xx or a transport failure of the list or the create is retried without it (id 88). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184). Also records a Delete Aura refused (reason DeletionRefused, id 201).

name: AuraSnapshotCreated
description: Emitted once CreateSnapshot is accepted and status.snapshotId is recorded.

name: AuraSnapshotFailed
description: Warning: requesting or reading an AuraSnapshot failed with an error a retry does not clear (reason CreateFailed or ObserveFailed); fail() set phase Error with the Ready condition. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase or the condition: once per failure, not on every 30s retry, nor after an operator restart. A 409 (snapshot-not-allowed while Aura's own snapshot runs) and a 429, 5xx or transport failure are retried without it (knowledge operations.md ids 145, 156).

name: AuraRestoreStarted
description: Emitted when RestoreSnapshot is accepted and the AuraRestore CR moves to Restoring.

name: AuraRestoreCompleted
description: Emitted when the target instance returns to Running status after a restore was issued.

name: AuraRestoreFailed
description: Emitted when the target instance enters an unexpected status during a restore, or RestoreSnapshot is rejected outright.

name: AuraDatabaseAdopted
description: Emitted when the external-database-id annotation already pinned an existing database, since v2beta1 returns no database names to match by.

name: AuraDatabaseCreated
description: Emitted after CreateDatabase succeeds; also used (as a Warning) to flag creating into an instance that already has other databases, since duplicates cannot be detected by name.

name: AuraDatabaseReady
description: Emitted when the database becomes Ready. Emitted when the status write that records it changed the phase or the Ready condition, read inside the conflict retry — not on every 5-minute re-observe, nor on a lastSyncedTime refresh, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md ids 136 and 156).

name: AuraDatabaseDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteDatabase under a non-Orphan deletionPolicy.

name: AuraDatabaseOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the database in place under deletionPolicy=Orphan. A Warning when deletionPolicy is Delete but the database cannot be deleted: at once when its AuraInstance CR no longer exists (the credentials come through it; the database went with the instance if that was deleted in Aura, otherwise it is still there with its data), and after finalizerDeletionGracePeriod when the credentials, the organization or project, or the instance ID stayed unavailable, or Aura kept refusing the DELETE: the database stays on the instance with its data (operations.md ids 157, 201, 202). It was a Normal event, at once, for any of these.

name: AuraDatabaseFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for TargetUnresolved, CreateFailed (including InstanceNotMultiDatabase) and ObserveFailed reasons. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). The InstanceNotMultiDatabase refusal, once on status for the current generation and the same Aura instance, is not asked again (id 156). A 429, a 5xx or a transport failure of the list or the create is retried without it (id 88). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184). Also records a Delete that waits for what it needs to reach Aura (reason CredentialsUnavailable, id 202) or on a DELETE Aura refused (reason DeletionRefused, id 201).

name: AuraDatabaseBackupCreated
description: Emitted once CreateDatabaseBackup accepts the one-shot backup request.

name: AuraDatabaseBackupFailed
description: Emitted by fail() when resolving the database/target or taking the backup fails. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A 429, a 5xx, a transport failure or a 409 (another operation in flight) of the backup create is retried without it, as the snapshot create does (id 88). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184).

name: AuraDatabaseRestoreStarted
description: Emitted just before RestoreDatabase is called, after the ambiguous Submitting marker has been persisted.

name: AuraDatabaseRestoreCompleted
description: Emitted when RestoreDatabase is accepted (202); named 'Completed' in events.go but the CR phase is Submitted because v2beta1 exposes no way to observe restore completion.

name: AuraDatabaseRestoreFailed
description: Emitted by fail() when resolving the database/backup/target or the RestoreDatabase call itself fails. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184).

name: AuraMemberNotFound
description: Emitted (Warning) when the target email is not found as an org or project member and must be invited via AuraInvite first. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: AuraMemberRoleUpdated
description: Emitted when UpdateOrgMemberRole/UpdateProjectMemberRole changes a member's role, or AddProjectMember adds an org member to a project.

name: AuraMemberReady
description: Emitted when an organization or project membership becomes Ready (the member's role matches spec.role). Emitted when the status write that records it changed the phase or the Ready condition, read inside the conflict retry — not on every 5-minute re-observe, nor on a lastSyncedTime refresh, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md ids 136 and 156).

name: AuraMemberRemoved
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteOrgMember/DeleteProjectMember under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraMemberFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CredentialsUnavailable, TargetMissing, LookupFailed, AddFailed and UpdateFailed reasons. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184). Also the wait of a deletionPolicy=Delete deletion for credentials it cannot resolve (reason CredentialsUnavailable, phase Error), announced once (operations.md id 178). Also records a Delete Aura refused (reason DeletionRefused, id 201).

name: AuraInviteAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing pending invite by email and project scope.

name: AuraInviteCreated
description: Emitted after CreateInvite succeeds with the two-slot organization/project role body.

name: AuraInviteReady
description: Emitted when the invite's v2beta1 status, mapped to a CR phase, changes: once per state (Sent, Accepted, Declined, Expired, Revoked); the message names the phase. Emitted when the status write that records it changed the phase or the Ready condition, read inside the conflict retry — not on every 5-minute re-observe, nor on a lastSyncedTime refresh, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md ids 136 and 156).

name: AuraInviteDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteInvite under a non-Orphan deletionPolicy.

name: AuraInviteOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the invite pending: a Normal event under deletionPolicy=Orphan; a Warning when deletionPolicy=Delete could not resolve the credentials or the organization within finalizerDeletionGracePeriod, so the finalizer is released, the invite stays pending in Aura and can still be accepted (operations.md ids 157, 178). Also a Warning when Aura kept refusing the DELETE for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (operations.md id 201).

name: AuraInviteFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CreateFailed/ObserveFailed and other non-refusal errors. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). A 429, a 5xx or a transport failure of the list or the create is retried without it (id 88); the OrganizationRoleRequired refusal, once on status for the current generation, is not asked again (id 156). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184). Also the wait of a deletionPolicy=Delete deletion for credentials it cannot resolve (reason CredentialsUnavailable, phase Error), announced once (operations.md id 178). Also records a Delete Aura refused (reason DeletionRefused, id 201).

name: AuraCredentialsValidated
description: Emitted when the AuraProviderConfig's credentials produce a working token and a successful ListInstances call and the status write changed the Ready condition: when they become valid, and again after a failure — not on every 30s revalidation (knowledge operations.md id 136).

name: AuraCredentialsInvalid
description: Emitted (Warning) when the credential exchange or the proving ListInstances call fails. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184).

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing key by name and confirms it via keyId/region/cloudProvider/instanceType before adopting.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyCreated
description: Emitted after CreateCustomerManagedKey succeeds and the external-cmk-id annotation is persisted.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyReady
description: Emitted when the key becomes ready (aura.IsCMKReady(observed.Status)). Emitted when the status write that records it changed the phase or the Ready condition, read inside the conflict retry — not on every 5-minute re-observe, nor on a lastSyncedTime refresh, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md ids 136 and 156).

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyDeleteBlocked
description: Emitted (Warning) when DeleteCustomerManagedKey is refused (400 encryption-key-is-active) because an instance still uses the key. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). The wait is bounded: Synced=False with reason KeyInUse names the deadline, and once finalizerDeletionGracePeriod has passed the finalizer is released with a Warning AuraCustomerManagedKeyOrphaned; it waited for ever, holding the namespace Terminating (operations.md id 201).

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyDeleted
description: Emitted when DeleteCustomerManagedKey succeeds under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyOrphaned
description: Emitted (Normal) when handleDeletion leaves the key registered under the default Orphan deletionPolicy, or when managementPolicies does not permit Delete. A Warning instead when deletionPolicy is Delete but the Aura credentials could not be resolved for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) after deletion was requested: the finalizer is released without deleting, and the message says the resource was left in Aura (knowledge operations.md id 157). Also a Warning when Aura kept refusing the DELETE, or the key was still in use, for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod: the key stays registered in Aura (operations.md id 201).

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CredentialsUnavailable, ProjectIDMissing, CreateFailed and ObserveFailed reasons. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). Also records a Delete that waits for Aura credentials it cannot resolve (reason CredentialsUnavailable, id 157). fail() sets status.phase=Error with the Ready condition (id 156). A 429, a 5xx or a transport failure of the list or the create is retried without it (id 88). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184). Also records a Delete Aura refused (reason DeletionRefused, id 201).

name: AuraIPFilterAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing IP filter by name.

name: AuraIPFilterCreated
description: Emitted after CreateIPFilter succeeds.

name: AuraIPFilterUpdated
description: Emitted after reconcileDrift's UpdateIPFilter call converges allow_list, filtered_entities, name or filteringDisabled.

name: AuraIPFilterReady
description: Emitted when the IP filter becomes Ready. Emitted when the status write that records it changed the phase or the Ready condition, read inside the conflict retry — not on every 5-minute re-observe, nor on a lastSyncedTime refresh, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md ids 136 and 156).

name: AuraIPFilterDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteIPFilter under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraIPFilterOrphaned
description: Emitted (Normal) when handleDeletion leaves the filter in place under deletionPolicy=Orphan, or when managementPolicies does not permit Delete. A Warning instead when deletionPolicy is Delete but the Aura credentials or organization could not be resolved for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod (5 minutes) after deletion was requested: the finalizer is released without deleting, and the message says the resource was left in Aura (knowledge operations.md id 157). Also a Warning when Aura kept refusing the DELETE for finalizerDeletionGracePeriod: the filter stays in place (operations.md id 201).

name: AuraIPFilterFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CredentialsUnavailable, OrganizationMissing, InstanceRefUnresolved, CreateFailed and ObserveFailed reasons. Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145). Also records a Delete that waits for Aura credentials it cannot resolve (reason CredentialsUnavailable, id 157). A 429, a 5xx or a transport failure of the list or the create is retried without it (id 88). The status message leaves Aura's per-response request ID out, so a refusal that repeats is the same status and one Warning; the Warning keeps the first failure's request ID (operations.md id 184). Also records a Delete Aura refused (reason DeletionRefused, id 201).

name: PluginInstalled
description: Normal event, once per install, from the status write that turns a Neo4jPlugin Ready: its write reached every server (the target's StatefulSet rolled the template out and the pods are ready). A pass that read an older copy of the plugin writes nothing and announces nothing (operations.md id 136).

name: PluginInstallFailed
description: Emitted when merging a Neo4jPlugin into its target or configuring it fails for a reason that needs action (including a variable the cluster's own spec sets, which the plugin will not overwrite). Emitted once per failure; the plugin is retried every RequeueAfter without repeating it. A StatefulSet conflict or an unreachable server while the servers restart is not a failure: the plugin stays Installing and no event is emitted. Also an install the target's spec refuses ("Plugin <name> installation refused: …"), announced from the status write that makes the plugin Failed; that refusal is logged once at info, never as an ERROR (operations.md id 228).

name: PluginDuplicate
description: Warning on an enabled Neo4jPlugin when another live enabled CR in the same namespace targets the same clusterRef with the same spec.name and owns it: an enabled CR wins over a disabled one, then the older creationTimestamp, then the lower UID. The CR that loses is marked Failed ("duplicate Neo4jPlugin: "<winner>" (older) … delete one CR, or set spec.enabled: false on one, …") and writes nothing, rather than racing on the shared NEO4J_PLUGINS value. A disabled CR is never a duplicate and never holds an enabled one back: it is Disabled and names the CR that installs the plugin in its place (operations.md id 195). Emitted after the status write that records it, and only when that write changed the phase, the message or the Ready condition: once per failure, not on every retry, nor after an operator restart (knowledge operations.md id 145).

name: PluginMissing
description: Warning on a Ready Neo4jPlugin whose target StatefulSet no longer carries what the plugin set (its NEO4J_PLUGINS entry, a variable it sets, a VerifiedDownload init container or one of its volumes, or, on a standalone, a leftover env copy of its neo4j.conf settings is still there). The plugin goes back to Installing and restores it, which restarts the servers; while the target is not Ready with every server available, the event says so and the plugin is Waiting until it is. A StatefulSet that does not exist is not drift and raises nothing (operations.md id 177).

name: PluginInstallDeferred
description: Normal event, once per wait, on a Neo4jPlugin whose install — or, for a VerifiedDownload plugin, whose update of its plugin-ca volume after the target's spec.trustedCASecrets changed ("updating the plugin's trusted CAs restarts every server") — would change its target's StatefulSet (restarting every server) while the target is not Ready with every server available, or has not rolled out its latest spec: a cluster with a server down (Degraded condition True, or phase Degraded), or still forming, rolling or upgrading; a target whose status.observedGeneration lags its generation, or whose StatefulSet is still rolling its template out; a standalone not Ready. The plugin is Waiting and installs once the target is fully available. A pass with nothing to write (waiting for the servers its own install restarted) is not held, nor is a write that repairs the plugin's own failing init container (PluginInitContainerFailing). Also emitted when the removal of a plugin set to spec.enabled false waits ("removing the disabled plugin restarts every server").

name: PluginInitContainerFailing
description: On a VerifiedDownload Neo4jPlugin whose own init container (plugin-init-<name>) keeps server pods from starting. A Warning, once, when the plugin writes the change that repairs it to a target that is not Ready: the write changes that init container or a volume it mounts, every server pod that is down is failing in it (exited non-zero, not succeeded since), those pods are the highest ordinals at or above the partition, no pod is missing or terminating, and Neo4j's last diagnostics report no other server unavailable — so the roll replaces the failing pods first and costs no server that is up (knowledge operations.md id 152). A Normal event when the plugin deletes a standalone's pod stuck in that container on an older revision, which its OrderedReady StatefulSet does not replace.

name: PluginSettingsFailing
description: On a Neo4jPlugin whose write changes the settings (NEO4J_<setting> variables) that every server that is down keeps failing with — typically a spec.config key Neo4j refuses at startup, removed from the plugin, or the plugin's removal when it is disabled or refused by its target's image (operations.md id 170). A Warning, once, when the plugin writes that change to a target that is not Ready: every server pod that is down has its neo4j container exited non-zero and not running again while running a variable the write changes, those pods are the highest ordinals at or above the partition, no pod is missing or terminating, and Neo4j's last diagnostics report no other server unavailable — so the roll replaces the failing pods first and costs no server that is up (knowledge operations.md id 155). A Normal event when the plugin deletes a standalone's pod stuck on the old settings on an older revision, which its OrderedReady StatefulSet does not replace.

name: UpstreamClusterNotFound
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamClusterRef names a Neo4jEnterpriseCluster that does not exist (yet) in the given namespace; the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: UpstreamClusterNotReady
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamClusterRef resolves to a real Neo4jEnterpriseCluster, but it has not yet published status.internalAddresses; the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: UpstreamBackupNotFound
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamBackupRef names a Neo4jBackup CR that does not exist (yet) in the given namespace; the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: UpstreamBackupNotReady
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamBackupRef resolves to a real Neo4jBackup CR, but it has not yet run a backup (status.replicationPullURI is empty); the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: PrivilegeTargetDropped
